postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n-1 numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= r_i < i for r_i in output)
postconditions.description: Each number r_i must be a non-negative integer less than i.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(a_j for j in range(1, i+1) if path[j-1] == 1) >= sum(b_j for j in range(1, r_i+1) if path[j-1] == 1) for i in range(2, n+1))
postconditions.description: For each vertex i, the sum of a_j along the path from the root to i must be greater than or equal to the sum of b_j along the maximum prefix of this path such that r_i is defined.
